description: This file implements a custom tab layout component for Android, called SlidingTabLayout, that works in conjunction with a ViewPager to display scrollable tabs with customizable colors, layouts, and interaction behaviors. It manages the creation, styling, and interaction of tab views, and handles synchronization with the ViewPager's page changes.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom view extending HorizontalScrollView to provide a configurable tab strip interface synchronized with a ViewPager for Android apps.

classes.name: TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface allowing custom control over the indicator and divider colors for tabs.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicators and dividers.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Defines the colors used to indicate the selected tab, supports multiple colors for cycling.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Defines the colors used for the dividers between tabs, supports multiple colors for cycling.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Assigns a page change listener to synchronize tab updates with ViewPager's page scrolls.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Specifies a custom layout and TextView ID for tab views.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Associates the layout with a ViewPager, populating tabs based on the adapter's page titles.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default styled TextView for tabs if no custom layout is specified.
